items.claim: CEO 引述第二季 AA&S 與全公司利潤率（AA&S 一年前為 14%）
items.quote: about 22% margin in AA&S segment, 23% across the business
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: CEO 表示目前增量利潤率約 50%，並預期全年持續
items.quote: we're at 50% incrementals today, and that's phenomenal
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: CEO 提到進入 2027 的隱含 EBITDA run rate 為 13.5 億美元
items.quote: run rate of going into 2027 at $1.35 billion of EBITDA
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 2027 年將有今年價格與合約重設的全年效應
items.quote: a full year of these price and contractual resets
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 今年 CapEx 區間 2.8–3.0 億美元，約 20% 為客戶出資
items.quote: between $280 million to $300 million
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: CEO 說 11 月將舉辦投資人日，屆時分享前瞻細節
items.quote: we've got an Investor Day that's going to be in November
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 內部資本專案報酬率門檻為 30% IRR（未計客戶出資前）
items.quote: So that's a 30% IRR target.
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 合約續約／重設預定在年底前進行
items.quote: resetting and renewing these contracts
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 鎳超合金重熔設備已進入試車，初熔設備明年底試車
items.quote: we are in commissioning for the remelt assets today
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 擴產順序：先以 Elevation 擠出現有資產產能，再與客戶談新產能
items.quote: First thing we do is we start with Elevation.
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 客戶出資換取工程資源優先排序，加速新資產認證
items.quote: the scarce resource they have is their engineering talent
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 客戶為搶產能願意接受漲價；噴射引擎與其他市場的獲利差距在縮小
items.quote: narrowing of the gap between jet engine and our
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 客戶分散供應商而要求 ATI 認證，仍見市占與 mix 改善
items.quote: still seeing share gains, mix improvements
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 國防上季成長 36%，飛彈成長 4 倍，Tomahawk 與 THAAD 開始下單
items.quote: Defense, defense has been a bright spot.
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 噴射引擎業務目前 50% 為 MRO
items.quote: jet engine being 50% MRO today for us
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 熱區 7 種專有合金中 ATI 獨家供應 5 種
items.quote: We make 5 of them sole-source providers
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: ATI 是全球兩家具等溫鍛造能力之一
items.quote: We're 1 of 2 globally that have that capability.
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 鉿鋯為三家西方合格供應商之一，且是唯一無自有商用核能業務者
items.quote: We're the only independent.
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 對 GE 收購 CPP 的看法：ATI 不做鑄件、不供貨 CPP，影響很小
items.quote: we don't really supply to CPP at all
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: Richland 新鈦資產正在認證
items.quote: qualifying our new asset that we just brought online
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 太空應用目前占比仍小，管理層預期大幅成長
items.quote: Small today, still a very small part.
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 中國貿易限制（含鉿鋯）被管理層視為價格與 mix 的背景因素
items.quote: trade restrictions with China
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields

items.claim: 管理層稱現有 HPMC 與 AA&S 兩個利潤結構相近的成長引擎
items.quote: Now we have 2 that are very similar in margin profiles
items.speaker: Kimberly Fields
